items.title: Awesome Vue
items.content_text:
### Projects Using Vue.js / Open Source

*   [fresfolio (⭐0)](https://github.com/dkioroglou/fresfolio) - a browser-based note-taking app for managing personal and research projects. The app uses Flask as backend and Vue.js as frontend leveraging the Quasar framework for UI components and responsive design.

### Projects Using Vue.js / Commercial Products

*   [Litlyx](https://litlyx.com) - AI-powered web analytics platform. Open-source alternative to Google Analytics 4 and Mixpanel.

### Components & Libraries / UI Components

*   [GridSheet (⭐183)](https://github.com/walkframe/gridsheet) - Highly customizable spreadsheet engine with formula support, multi-sheet references, and a Vue3 wrapper built on a Preact core.
*   [vue-my-dropdown (⭐31)](https://github.com/david-cm-dev/vue-my-dropdown) - A customizable dropdown component for Vue 3 with TypeScript support.

### Components & Libraries / UI Utilities

*   [piying-view (⭐5)](https://github.com/piying-org/piying-view) - Frontend Form Solution; strongly typed; Vue 3
*   [validation-composable (⭐17)](https://github.com/nexxtmove/validation-composable) - ✅ Lightweight validation for Vue — just 40 lines of code.
*   [timered-counter (⭐7)](https://github.com/siaikin/timered-counter) A counter web component with smooth animations

### Components & Libraries / Dev Tools

*   [Vue Log Arsenal (⭐31)](https://github.com/MvdZon/Vue3-log-arsenal) - Lightweight Vue 3 plugin providing logging directives for easier debugging
*   [vue-flow-vis (⭐24)](https://github.com/MiloradFilipovic/vue-flow-vis) - real-time monitoring of component renders and reactive dependency tracking
